authorization.source: explicit user authorization in the current task
allowed: read-only access to frozen BLIND runtime evidence on A
forbidden: v10/v11 retry, requeue, rerun, or output reuse
training before R06, R07, R13 and independent audit all pass

join_policy.unique_rule: exactly one same-mode source-basename match, falling back to exact run_id, with nonempty measured wall time
join_policy.timeout_nonzero_rule: chargeable when measured wall time is present
join_policy.not_run_rule: TARGET_BEFORE_F and INFEASIBLE_AT_D95 suppress only F; generic NOT_RUN or PRUNED suppresses only pathless modes

gates.R07: unique == executed references, missing == 0, coverage == 1.0, and every eligible action has all required references UNIQUE
gates.R13: every registered method binds to the identical per-circuit eligible action hash
gates.training: allowed only after independent audit seals PASS for R06, R07 and R13

implementation.binding_rule: The runner hashes every listed file before opening BLIND evidence; the receipt records both contract_sha256 and implementation_set_sha256.
